title: 第5章 时过境迁第6章 想太多
lines: 一晃眼，一坤年后。
赵国边境。
站在悬崖边遥望边境之城，白羽忍不住感慨道：“我终于回来了。”
耗时两年半，十几万公里的路程。
回首，遥望紫云仙宗，白羽低声道：“修不了仙又如何，由得你们去争渡，我只管抱着无尽寿元享受人生。”
说罢，他纵身一跃跳下悬崖。
他不会飞，但雄厚的内力可助他滑行，快落地时再用内力外放运用技巧卸力便可安然无恙。
进入赵国领土，他算是回到这一世的家乡了。
此地，江湖上有哥的传说。
修真界虽不如意，但在这凡俗之中，哥们儿曾也是十里八乡有名的俊后生。
边境之城，自然集交易与防守为一体。
此地兵马多，来往客商也多。
入得城池，里面好生热闹，来来往往行人络绎不绝，奇装异服各色各样。
买了些小吃，白羽便找了间客栈打算今日在这歇歇脚。
开好房，他又点了一桌子菜。
小二上菜，白羽随手丢出一个金币道：“小二慢走，且坐下与我聊聊。”
小二是个实诚人，当即活也不干了，直接坐下开聊。
从他这里，白羽得知赵国近二十年来的情况。
原来，江湖上已经没有哥的传说了。
时间终会冲淡一切。
初时人们或许还记得住，但当他久不现身，那又还有谁会关注呢？
没人关注，渐渐得便被世人遗忘。
当年，哪个茶楼不会说上两段他的故事可是都会生意不好的。
一代新人换旧人，江山代有才人出。
地儿还是那个地儿，但主角已经换人了。
近年来，江湖声名显赫的乃是断刀门新任掌门。
这个门派白羽知道，使得一手断刀，刀法相当了得。
当年他们老掌门与自己私下切磋比武，输了以后就求他别宣扬出去。
白羽心善，答应他了，然后让别人宣扬出去。
嗯，真没宣扬，别人干得与我何干？
二十年，想来那位掌门也确实该退了，新任掌门据说才四十几岁，这样看来也是和白羽同龄的人。
小二算个百事通，枯燥的生活里也很喜欢看一些画本和听一些江湖传说，回答起江湖事物来滔滔不绝。
听了许久，一直没听到有关自家门派的，于是白羽问道：“小二呀，‘日月同辉’派你听过没有？”
“日月同辉？”
小二有些疑惑，思索一会儿忽然恍然大悟道：“喔，这个门派啊，我听过。
据说二十几年前很出名，有个了不得的天才，后来听说那人寻仙去了，这门派也就销声匿迹。”
小二问道：“客官怎么问这个门派，要不是我看的话本和听的故事多，还真不一定知道。”
“销声匿迹？”
呢喃一声，白羽让小二接着讲别的。
自家这个门派，说起来确实不算什么大派，毕竟人丁稀薄。
日月同辉，取这名字只因两位师祖是一对恩爱夫妻，收徒弟也只收一男一女。
最多也就四个人，怎么不算人丁稀薄呢。
当然，每代虽是一男一女，但也不一定都会成为夫妻。
至少，白羽的师父和他这一代就没成。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, one Kun year later.
The border of Zhao State.
Standing on the edge of the cliff and looking at the border city, Bai Yu couldn't help but sigh: "I'm finally back."
It took two and a half years and hundreds of thousands of kilometers to travel.
Looking back, looking at the Ziyun Immortal Sect in the distance, Bai Yu whispered: "So what if I can't become an immortal? It's up to you to fight for it. I just enjoy life with endless longevity."
After that, he jumped off the cliff.
He can't fly, but his strong internal strength can help him glide. When he's about to land, he can use his internal strength to release the force outwards and use techniques to relieve the force, and he'll be safe.
Entering the territory of Zhao State, he returned to his hometown in this life.
Here, there is a legend about Brother in the world.
Although the world of cultivation is unsatisfactory, in this ordinary world, my brother was once a well-known handsome young man from all over the country.
The border city naturally integrates trading and defense.
There are many soldiers and horses here, and there are also many merchants coming and going.
Entering the city, it was so lively, with an endless stream of people coming and going, wearing all kinds of fancy clothes.
After buying some snacks, Bai Yu found an inn and planned to rest here today.
After booking the room, he ordered another table of dishes.
When the waiter served the dishes, Bai Yu casually threw out a gold coin and said, "Waiter, please go slowly and sit down to chat with me."
The waiter was an honest man, so he stopped doing any work and just sat down to chat.
From him, Bai Yu learned about Zhao's situation in the past twenty years.
It turns out that there is no legend about Brother anymore in the world.
Time will eventually dilute everything.
People may still remember him at first, but when he doesn't show up for a long time, who else will pay attention?
No one pays attention to it, and gradually it is forgotten by the world.
In those days, any teahouse that couldn't tell these two stories about him would suffer bad business.
A new generation replaces the old, and talented people emerge from generation to generation.
The place is still the same place, but the protagonist has been changed.
In recent years, it is the new head of the Broken Blade Sect who has become famous in the world.
Bai Yu knew this sect and was very good at breaking a knife with one hand.
Back then, their old leader had a private competition with him, and after losing, he begged him not to publicize it.
Bai Yu was kind-hearted, agreed to him, and then let others publicize it.
Well, I really didn’t publicize it, so what does it have to do with me?
After twenty years, it was indeed time for that leader to retire. The new leader was said to be only in his forties, so it seemed that he was the same age as Bai Yu.
The waiter is a know-it-all. In his boring life, he also likes to read some picture books and listen to some legends of the world, and he can answer endless questions about the world.
After listening for a long time, he never heard anything about his sect, so Bai Yu asked: "Xiao Er, have you ever heard of the 'Sun and Moon Tonghui' sect?"
"The sun and the moon shine together?"
The waiter was a little confused, and after thinking for a while, he suddenly realized: "Oh, I've heard of this sect.
It is said that there was a great genius who was very famous more than 20 years ago. Later, I heard that the man went to seek immortality, and the sect disappeared. "
The waiter asked: "Why are you asking about this sect? If I hadn't read the book and heard many stories, I might not know."
"Disappeared?"
With a murmur, Bai Yu asked the waiter to continue talking about something else.
This sect of ours is indeed not a big sect, after all, the number of people is very small.
The sun and the moon shine together, so named because the two masters are a loving couple, and they only accept one boy and one girl as their disciples.
There are only four people at most, so why don't they be considered sparsely populated.
Of course, although there is one man and one woman in each generation, they may not necessarily become husband and wife.
At least, Bai Yu's master and his generation failed.
title_en: Chapter 5 Times have changed Chapter 6 Thinking too much
